about.title: About LMC Houston
text: Our professional management team includes LEED Certified Professionals, Certified Landscape Professionals through Professional Landscape Associated Network (PLANET) and Texas Nursery Landscape Association (TNLA), Certified Turfgrass Professionals, Texas Master Gardeners, Licensed Irrigators, Certified Arborists, Certified Commercial Pesticide Applicators and Texas Certified Landscape Technicians.
Lawn Management Company, Inc. is committed to providing safe working conditions for all its employees in compliance with all current and applicable occupational health, safety and environmental laws.

To this end, we will continually develop the operations, procedures, and policies we believe are needed to provide such conditions. We will train employees to work safely on their jobs and will expect them to work safely at all times. Employees should report unsafe working conditions promptly to their supervisor.
